title: Frictions, Failures, and Open Questions
summary: The honest module. Where the narratives break. Fraud, model collapse, regulatory capture, privacy, the moral arithmetic of energy, and the things we genuinely don't know.
learningOutcomes: Describe the recurring patterns of crypto fraud and why they keep working.
Explain model collapse and the limits of synthetic data.
Describe how regulatory capture works in emerging tech and who it benefits.
Articulate what privacy means in a world of perfect memory.
Lay out the energy and climate trade-offs honestly without picking a side first.
List five things in this domain we genuinely do not know.
